description:
Free mode only: replace the circuit in the human's browser (the simulation stops). components:
    [{type, id, properties, x?, y?}] (the board is not a component), wires: [{id, start: {componentId, pinName},
    end: {...}, color?, waypoints?: [{x, y}] (the wire's route, 16 points at most)}], in the shape of the setup
    sheet's circuit; 40 components, 120 wires, 48 KiB. The
    editor checks types and pins: read the outcome with read_simulation (circuit, circuit_error). 6 per minute.
name: push_circuit
title: Push a circuit
